title: Brownfield: import, drift and state migration
scenario:
Northwind Logistics runs its dispatch web tier in AWS. During an outage, an engineer launched the EC2 instances `nw-bf-web-1` and `nw-bf-web-2` by hand, together with the security group `nw-bf-web-sg`, the IAM role `nw-bf-web-role` and the instance profile `nw-bf-web-profile`. The configuration in `~/exam/brownfield` manages the security group `nw-bf-tracker-sg` and the S3 buckets `nw-bf-manifests` and `nw-bf-legacy-exports`. It has been applied with local state. Since then, `nw-bf-tracker-sg` was changed in the console.

The S3 bucket `nw-bf-tfstate` and the DynamoDB table `nw-bf-tf-locks` (partition key `LockID`) exist for remote state. Other teams use the same AWS account. The configuration is initialized, and the `aws` CLI is configured for the region `us-east-1`.

tasks.text:
Bring the hand-built dispatch web tier under Terraform management.

- Use `import` blocks. `-generate-config-out` is allowed.
- Addresses: `aws_instance.web["web-1"]` and `aws_instance.web["web-2"]` (one resource with `for_each`), `aws_security_group.web`, `aws_iam_role.web` and `aws_iam_instance_profile.web`.
- The instances must reference the security group and the instance profile, and the instance profile must reference the role. Do not hard-code IDs or names in these arguments.
- No resource may be modified or replaced.
tasks.validation: Run `terraform plan`. The plan should not propose any change to the five imported resources.

tasks.text:
Reconcile the drift on `nw-bf-tracker-sg`.

- The SSH ingress rule from `0.0.0.0/0` was not approved. Remove it.
- The tag `Owner = dispatch-oncall` was approved. Keep it and add it to the configuration.
- The security group must not be replaced.
tasks.validation: Run `aws ec2 describe-security-groups --group-names nw-bf-tracker-sg`. The output should show only the 8443 ingress rule and the tag `Owner = dispatch-oncall`.

tasks.text:
Clean up the state of the storage resources.

- Rename `aws_s3_bucket.manifests` to `aws_s3_bucket.shipping_manifests` without recreating the bucket.
- The finance team takes over `nw-bf-legacy-exports`. Stop managing it in this configuration and remove its configuration, but do not delete the bucket.
tasks.validation: Run `terraform state list`. The output should include `aws_s3_bucket.shipping_manifests` and no resource for `nw-bf-legacy-exports`, and `aws s3api head-bucket --bucket nw-bf-legacy-exports` should succeed.

tasks.text:
Migrate the state to the S3 backend.

- Bucket `nw-bf-tfstate`, key `brownfield/terraform.tfstate`, region `us-east-1`.
- Lock the state with the DynamoDB table `nw-bf-tf-locks` and enable encryption.
- The local state file must no longer hold any resources. Finish with a clean plan.
tasks.validation: Run `aws s3 ls s3://nw-bf-tfstate/brownfield/`. The output should list `terraform.tfstate`, and `terraform plan` should report no changes.
